timing_boundary.description: Wall perf_counter starts before per-microbatch events/forward and is read after synchronize and elapsed_time calls for forward/backward/optimizer. Thus post-sync event-read calls lie inside wall; last loss .item()/finite check lie outside. Warmups follow the same path.
timing_boundary.cause_attribution: No measurement here establishes that event-read calls, host gaps, clocks, allocation, compilation, or another factor caused the remainder difference.
